page.notes: Several page numbers and words are uncertain at the scan's resolution: "Flenda" (first letters unclear), "proficitur", "fœdus nouum & ueius" (the last word is unclear, likely "uetus"), "Gaal" (the large G initial is joined to the word, and the page number is unclear), "gideone mortuo ... scortati" (the word is probably "fcortati", as printed). Long s is rendered as s throughout; the printed f in fœdus, finis, fratres and the like is read as a real f. The text is not further marked because the page is legible at this scale.
